advisories.headline: Pre-Cyclone Watch: Cyclone Titli 2018 assessment for Andhra Pradesh landfall coast
advisories.situation: At 72.0 hours before landfall, heuristic modeling indicates a peak surge index of 1.98 m and a potential flood extent of 42.9 km2 along the Andhra Pradesh landfall coast. The projected inundation places 13958 population and 838 buildings at risk, while 0 of 14 shelters are compromised. With 12886 people without a shelter place, opening temporary shelter for 12886 people beyond cyclone-shelter capacity is recommended for administrative action.
caveats: Static bathtub inundation; no storm dynamics, tide phase, or timing.
No wave setup or runup, which can add more than 1 m.
DEM vertical error (several metres) is comparable to the surge signal itself in low-relief floodplains.

advisories.headline: ବାତ୍ୟା-ପୂର୍ବ ସତର୍କତା: ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ପ୍ରଦେଶ ଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡଫଲ୍ ଉପକୂଳ ପାଇଁ Cyclone Titli 2018 ଆକଳନ
advisories.situation: ଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡଫଲ୍‌ର 72.0 ଘଣ୍ଟା ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ହିଉରିଷ୍ଟିକ୍ ମଡେଲିଂ ଆନ୍ଧ୍ର ପ୍ରଦେଶ ଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡଫଲ୍ ଉପକୂଳରେ 1.98 m ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ଜୁଆର ସୂଚକାଙ୍କ ଏବଂ 42.9 km2 ର ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ବନ୍ୟା ବିସ୍ତାର ଦର୍ଶାଉଛି। ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପିତ ଜଳପ୍ଲାବନ ଯୋଗୁଁ 13958 ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟା ଏବଂ 838 ଟି କୋଠା ବିପଦରେ ରହିଛନ୍ତି, ଯେତେବେଳେ କି 14 ଟି ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ 0 ଟି ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୋଇଛି। 12886 ଜଣ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳ ନ ଥିବାରୁ, ବାତ୍ୟା ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀ କ୍ଷମତା ବାହାରେ 12886 ଲୋକଙ୍କ ନିମନ୍ତେ ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଆଶ୍ରୟସ୍ଥଳୀ ଖୋଲିବାକୁ ପ୍ରଶାସନିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ପାଇଁ ସୁପାରିଶ କରାଯାଉଛି।
caveats: Static bathtub inundation; no storm dynamics, tide phase, or timing.
No wave setup or runup, which can add more than 1 m.
DEM vertical error (several metres) is comparable to the surge signal itself in low-relief floodplains.
